notes.title: Community Update #13 Patch 0.2.32 - Balancing!
notes.content:
Greetings, [b]Travelers[/b]!

Patch 0.2.32 is here and a balancing overhaul has been done to objects pricing!

You will find now prices being much lower and having more sense. For example all the iron cutlery are down to 10, while silver cutlery are 100. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/AHaVcpq.png[/img]
The balancing is probably not perfect, so if you have any suggestions feel free to let us now on Discord!

For the next updates we will focus on adding more items and the ability to trade gold between players, this should make working on customizing the tavern easier!

[b]See you in Taverna![/b]

Discord: [url=https://discord.com/invite/hvPkJrqQRX]https://discord.com/invite/hvPkJrqQRX[/url]

notes.title: Community Update #12 Taverna is out!
notes.content:
Greetings, [b]Travelers[/b]!

Taverna is now released in Early Access! Hurray!🎉

For the release of the game we added localization for simplified Chinese, more will follow over time like Russian, Italian, Spanish, German and more. Are you a native Chinese? Tell us what do you think about the translation and if there anything we can improve.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/36WcHR7.jpeg[/img]

Even though we just released, there are already a lot of improvements that we are cooking for you to have soon. More specifically:
[list][*] Trade gold with other players
[*] Paint outside walls
[*] Add the Flute instrument
[*] More presets and character customizations
[*] More items
[*] Debuffs system for eating, drinking and toxicity
[*] More interesting quests
[*] More accurate prices balance
[/list]
Do you have any questions or ideas? Chat with us on Discord! Let's make this project amazing together.

[b]See you in Taverna![/b]

Discord: [url=https://discord.com/invite/hvPkJrqQRX]https://discord.com/invite/hvPkJrqQRX[/url]

notes.title: Community Update #11 Early Access launches on May 26th!
notes.content:
Greetings, [b]Travelers[/b]!

We are excited to announce the release of Taverna [b]on May 26th on Steam![/b]

During the last weeks we have been working hard on bringing new features into the game. 

Taverna has a [b]new game mode: Tycoon[/b], every few minutes your tavern will be valuated based on what you place, the valuation will be then reported into a world ranking, visible in the main menu!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3ebA2lT.png[/img]

Another feature that we implemented is a [b]new quest system[/b]: connected to Steam achievements there will be missions that you can complete to unlock new roles. We may expand in the future on this mechanic to let you discover new items, paint colors and character customization options.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0TVvUm7.png[/img]

Do you have any questions or ideas? Chat with us on Discord! Let's make this project amazing together.

[b]See you in Taverna![/b]

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/hvPkJrqQRX

notes.title: Community Update #9 Taverna updated to Godot 4.4
notes.content:
Greetings, [b]Travelers[/b]!

With the release of [b]Godot 4.4[/b] at the beginning of March, we decided it was the right moment to update Taverna to the latest tech.

What are the improvements? There's a lot on the table.

[b]Jolt physics engine[/b] has been officially included into the engine (it was an extension before), this will allow us in the future to add physics prediction easily to the game, that will reduce noticeably latency as client while interacting with objects. It will not come soon, but we already have done some tests and it's going to be amazing.

Shaders stutters are almost solved now. With the introduction of [b]ubershaders[/b], compiling will be only occur a couple of times, so the overall initial experience is going to be improved.

A new tonemapping has been introduced: [b]AgX[/b]. We are still experimenting with it, but as it stands it's a nice graphical improvement with no performance costs. 

[b]Physics interpolation[/b]. Finally it arrived for 3D as well. It will allow us to further reduce CPU load as we can easily drop the physics tick to something like 10-15 (from 30). It only effects the server, but it's a nice performance improvements for lower-end pcs.

[b]UID (Unique idenfifier)[/b] has been extended to scripts and shaders. The absence of this massive necessary feature has been crippling the project for a while now and it's been solved. What it means is faster iterations on debugging and refactoring. Without this feature, refactoring on specific scripts has been impossibile.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/a6hyfzt.png[/img]
[i]from Sithoid on Discord 💗
[/i]
All this will come in the next update, available for all in the demo. 

Thanks for all the feedback sent, work is being done and we appreciate so much every one of you taking the time to write to us.

See you in Taverna!

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/hvPkJrqQRX

notes.title: Community Update #7 Demo is available now!
notes.content:
Greetings, [b]Travelers[/b]!

The long await [b]demo has been released[/b]!

You will be able to play as a human traveler, create your own tavern or join others.

Is demo perfect? No... I mean yes... I mean no, not at all, but we are continuing updating it and we need your support for feedback / report bugs / suggest new features so write us on Discord or via email! (remember no feedback is a bad feedback)

What features you can expect from the demo:
[list]
[*] Drawing
[*] Coating
[*] Minimal outfit customization
[*] Playing the gittern
[*] Customizing the tavern through various actions (pose, nail)
[*] A lot of fun small interactions! (don't burn the red barrel)
[/list]

[b]We want to see what you create[/b], feel free to post your screenshots in Discord!

notes.title: Community Update #6 Taverna on the upcoming February Next-Fest!
notes.content:
Greetings, [b]Travelers[/b]!

It's [b]February 1st, 00:00[/b], where is the demo promised in January? 

Well... The team had some personal life inconveniences that made us decide to delay the demo release for couple of weeks.

Although all the current developed features will be present in the demo, we want to focus this release on painting. There are a few reasons for this but mainly is giving new players a clear gameplay target to explore. Some of the features included in the demo are [b]painting, coating, music instruments, tavern customization[/b], and other interesting sandbox gimmicks. 

We are happy to announce that Taverna will be present in the upcoming February 2025 Steam Next Fest.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8cQVEZZ.jpeg[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kytACpl.jpeg[/img]

If you are interested about the project and have any questions, feel free to join our Discord and chat with us!

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/hvPkJrqQRX

Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1596615319/taverna-online-fantasy-roleplay-game

notes.title: Community Update #5 Role-Play!
notes.content:
Greetings, [b]Travelers[/b]!

Today, we’re talking about role-play. Roles are an important part of Taverna, as we see them as a way to give meaning to your character and provide an incipit to your story in the tavern.

Once you join a tavern, you will be able to choose your role. Depending on your choice, you will spawn with specific items (or more than one), and your role name will be displayed on the nameplate above your character.

Roles are divided into two categories: [b]Adventurers [/b](customers) and [b]Staff[/b].
As of now, we plan to include the following roles in the game:

Adventurers:
[list]
[*] Fortune Teller 
[*] Gambler 
[*] Blind 
[*] Hobo 
[*] Traveler 
[*] Bard 
[*] Flutist 
[*] Artist 
[*] Priest 
[*] Merchant
[*] The Drunk
[*] The Mute
[/list]Staff:
[list]
[*] Chef
[*] Cook 
[*] Stock Keeper 
[*] Waiter 
[*] Owner 
[*] Stoker 
[*] Bouncer
[/list]
Since we’re still in development, the only playable role in the demo will be [b]Traveler[/b].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6SD7O6g.jpeg[/img]

What role would you like to play in Taverna? Tell us on Discord!

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/hvPkJrqQRX

Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1596615319/taverna-online-fantasy-roleplay-game

notes.title: Community Update #4 Demo Coming Out On January 2025!
notes.content:
Greetings [b]Travelers[/b]!

Work continues tirelessly to bring out the demo of the game. We are pleased to announce that it will be released [b]next month, January 2025[/b] (the specific date will be announced in the near future).
For the demo you will be able to experience the "Creative" mode of the game. The objective is to give you a solid demonstration on what the game is in its core. 
A "Survival" mode will be added in the future with hunger, thirst debuffs and more.

For "this week's cool stuff"... [b]Fire![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZDbeeJz.gif[/img]

This will be the main way to destroy unwanted objects... Or proofs, the objects will disappear after some seconds after catching on fire. It's also possible to extinguish the fire using a specific interaction pointing on the object.



Feel free to join our Discord for more frequent updates.

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/hvPkJrqQRX

Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1596615319/taverna-online-fantasy-roleplay-game
